articles.summary: Academic research institutions are facing tightening capital budgets and funding uncertainty. At a time when academic researchers are being asked to do more with less, Volta is keeping Callisto accessible by launching the Volta Access Program; a new initiative aimed at increasing access to its Callisto™ Sample Prep System for academic research institutions in the U.S. facing tightening capital budgets. Selected applicants will be able to access Callisto for $4,950 per month over a 24-month term, with full service support and no consumables minimum — helping labs stay productive even as financial caution shapes decision-making across the academic community.
articles.title: Volta Labs Launches Access Program to Support Academic Researchers Amid Budget Cuts

articles.summary: The Volta Labs team is excited to announce our participation in the American Association of Cancer Research (AACR) Annual Meeting 2025, taking place April 25-30 in Chicago, Illinois. As the critical driver of progress against cancer, AACR brings together scientists, clinicians, and healthcare professionals to share groundbreaking advancements in cancer science and medicine.
articles.title: Volta Labs at AACR 2025: Showcasing Advanced Targeted Sequencing Solutions for Cancer Research
